Definition: from G4862 and the base of G5114; to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily):--(cut) short.
BiblicalUsage: He will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness, because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth. God's work is cut short, not left unfinished, and the cutting is His mercy: the days are shortened for the elect's sake.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that the Lord will finish His work and cut it short in righteousness, and I hold that His shortening is mercy, not failure.
